args.body: For NORTH-AYRSHIRE-LIVE-NOTICE-DELTA, reuse an equivalent committed current comparison if one exists. Otherwise use the two queued official captures under products/services/tender-refresh/north-ayrshire-delta/ after checking their receipts. Treat the official notice page as the single follow-up, and distinguish what it says about related releases from what the per-notice OCDS package establishes. Compare the current operative fields and actual live wording against the previously saved records. If there is a verified material change, deliver the bilingual correction and calendar change outside the site to ACQUISITION. If coverage is inconclusive, record exactly what was checked and what remains unknown. Read the committed result and close with a valid lease and a lesson. Preserve the superseding January 8 site retirement and the separate welfare dates.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so eligible demand remains unknown.
